Package service

Class FlightCatalogService

java.lang.Object
service.FlightCatalogService
public class FlightCatalogService extends Object
Service layer coordinating Flight operations between MySQL database and the ds.FlightBST data structure. Mirrors the MovieCatalog service architecture from the starter project blueprint.

    • sortFlightsWithBST

      public List<Flight> sortFlightsWithBST(List<Flight> flights)
      Sorts an in-memory collection of flights chronologically by departure time using ds.FlightBST via Java Reflection, or returns the original list if the BST is unavailable. This method enables decoupled unit testing without database dependency.
      Parameters:
      flights - the list of flights to sort
      Returns:
      a sorted list of flights
